title: 자막 시간 조정
summary: Six-language local SRT/WebVTT millisecond timing adjustment, bounded format conversion and overlap diagnostics.
features: UTF-8 file loading and editable text
Positive/negative millisecond offsets and time factor
Overlap participant count and unordered cue warning
Same-format cue ID/settings and literal payload preservation

tests.name: 7 independent timing, parsing, conversion, payload and overlap fixtures
6 routes, localized label indices and relative asset checks

limitations: Up to 1 MiB, 10000 cues, output under 100 hours
VTT NOTE/STYLE/REGION, extra header metadata and inline timestamps rejected
Conversion rejects nonshared tags and VTT cue settings
Input line endings normalize to LF
No speech recognition or video preview
Not a comprehensive WebVTT syntax validator
